_meta.title: Lumina — User guide
_meta.description: End-user guide: create a vault, settings, raw folder, ingest to build your wiki, ask questions, and run /lint.

themeAriaLight: Light background on. Activate to use a dark background.
themeAriaDark: Dark background on. Activate to use a light background.
guideLeadHtml: This guide walks through the raw → wiki → Q&A → lint loop in Lumina. Chat workflows follow the rules in your vault’s CLAUDE.md (empty vaults use a bundled template at runtime). Ingest extraction uses the built-in ingest_source tool per the bundled INGEST protocol.
installMacNoteHtml:
macOS (private beta). The distributed app is not Apple-notarized yet. After installing Lumina.app to /Applications, run once in Terminal:

xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Lumina.app

Then open Lumina from Finder.
s1Html:
A vault is a folder on disk that Lumina treats as the root of your library.

  1. On first launch (or when switching vaults), pick a folder in the welcome flow. Use an existing folder (e.g. an Obsidian vault) or create an empty folder first.
  2. If the folder has no CLAUDE.md yet, Lumina shows Initialize Vault. Confirm to create: an empty CLAUDE.md, raw/ for sources (read-only for the assistant), and wiki/ for structured pages.
  3. If you skip initialization, add CLAUDE.md, raw/, and wiki/ yourself so ingest and wiki workflows have a place to write.
  4. Keeping the vault inside Box, SharePoint, or Git is recommended for backup and collaboration outside Lumina.
s2Html:
Open Settings and configure at least:

SettingPurpose
API base URLYour OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint.
API keyAuthentication for the endpoint.
Model nameModel id expected by that endpoint.

Ingest-related options: Office/PDF text extraction may use Python and markitdown (Lumina can prepare a shared venv under ~/.lumina/venv/ on first use). Install Python 3 if the app tells you it is missing. For difficult PDFs, enable PDF page images so a vision-style retry is possible when the protocol allows (higher token use).
s3Html:
Copy or move source files into raw/ using Finder, Explorer, or the terminal. Convention: the assistant does not edit raw/; it only reads from there.

  • Typical types: plain text (.txt, .md, …), Office/PDF (.pdf, .pptx, …), images (.png, .jpg, …).
  • Naming tip: YYYY-MM-DD-short-title.ext helps traceability.
  • No separate “upload” step—once the file is under raw/, you can ingest it from chat.
s4Html:
Ingest means: extract content from a file in raw/, then create or update Markdown under wiki/ (sources, index, log, glossary, etc.) following CLAUDE.md.

  1. Open Chat.
  2. Run the slash command (path is vault-relative; sources usually live in raw/):
    /ingest your-file.pdf
    You can add a short instruction, e.g. /ingest "Quarterly Deck.pptx" summarize key risks
  3. The model calls ingest_source (never bypass it with manual pip/markitdown in the shell for extraction).
  4. If Python or markitdown is missing, follow the error text. If a PDF yields almost empty text and page images are enabled, the model may retry with a vision path per protocol.
  5. After a run, check wiki/sources/, wiki/index.md, and wiki/log.md in the Files view. One ingest often touches many wiki files—that is normal.
s5Html:
Use natural language in chat. Under the Query workflow the model should read wiki/index.md, open relevant pages, answer with citations, and may ask whether to save the answer under wiki/analyses/ so knowledge compounds.

Tip: Specific questions (a meeting, a raw file, a topic) get answers that align better with what you already ingested.
s6Html:
Lint asks the model to review the entire wiki/ for consistency—contradictions, stale claims, orphan pages, missing concepts, weak cross-links, and terminology drift.

  1. In chat, run:
    /lint
  2. Optional focus text on the same line, e.g. /lint focus on the entities pages
  3. Review the report; apply fixes where you agree. A wiki/log.md entry may be appended when the workflow completes.
  4. Run periodically after large ingests or on a schedule.
appendixHtml:
vault/
├── CLAUDE.md
├── raw/
└── wiki/
    ├── index.md
    ├── log.md
    ├── overview.md
    ├── glossary.md
    ├── sources/
    ├── entities/
    ├── concepts/
    ├── topics/
    └── analyses/

Page types, front matter, and wikilink rules follow your vault CLAUDE.md; when it is empty, Lumina uses the bundled template for those conventions.
